lines.en: I know. We used to walk to school together, remember?

lines.en: And I used to hate coffee, but now I drink three cups a day!

lines.en: Perfect. I used to miss those days, and now we can bring them back.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Eu sentia falta daqueles dias, e agora podemos trazê-los de volta.

facts.label: Used to e each other
facts.sub: Hábito do passado: used to + verbo. Negativa e pergunta: didn’t use to / Did you use to…? Ação mútua: each other.

facts.label: Costumava
facts.sub: Use used to para hábitos e situações do passado que não existem mais: We used to see each other every day. Depois de used to, use o verbo simples. Não serve para fatos pontuais.

facts.label: Não costumava
facts.sub: Para negar, use didn’t use to, sem o d final: We didn’t use to have phones. Para perguntar, use Did you use to…? O d de used sai porque did já mostra o passado.

pages.title: Friends who changed · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Saturday afternoon in Dallas. Grace and Tom meet in a park after a long time. They were close friends in school. Now each of them has a new routine. Grace works a lot, and Tom has a different schedule. The distance between them grew with time.

“We used to see each other every day. Now it is once a month.” says Grace. “I know. We used to walk to school together, remember?” says Tom. “Yes! We used to talk about everything on that long road.” says Grace.
